title: Persistency Rule Card: Whole Life Insurance Dividend Deposit After Returned Premium Payments
content:
**Whole Life Insurance (Ashgrove) — accumulate option.**

**Rule.** The dividend placed on deposit is lowered for interrupted premium payment, judged by the premium payments returned unpaid on the policy ledger and dated within the 12 calendar months before the day the deposit is processed: by **10% (0.1)** where there are two or more, by **5% (0.05)** where there is exactly one, and not at all where there is none.

**Counting.** Every returned premium payment entry counts, whatever the payment method. A return dated later than the same day of the month twelve months before the processing day is inside the window; one dated on that day or earlier is outside.

**Applying it.** The percentage is a share of the dividend being placed on deposit; percentage changes to the amount placed on deposit are added together and applied once to the dividend, never one on top of another, with one rounding half up to the cent at the end.

| Returned payments in the window | Lowered by |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10% |
| 1 | 5% |
| 0 | Not lowered |

**Card examples (hypothetical, deposit processed June 3, 2026, dividend 1240.00).**

- Returns dated November 4, 2025 and February 4, 2026: two in the window; 1240.00 lowered by 10% alone gives 1116.00.
- Returns dated June 3, 2025 and February 4, 2026: the first is exactly twelve months earlier and is outside; one return, lowered by 5% alone, 1178.00.
